:::{#exr-ds-lik-obs-lik}
#### Dataset likelihood from likelihood components

For mutually independent data $\vx \eqdef \x1n$,
use @thm-lik-iid
to write the likelihood of the dataset
in terms of the observations' [likelihood components](#def-lik-factor).
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-ds-lik-obs-lik}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Lik(\param)
&= \prodin \p(X_i = x_i \mid \param)
&& \text{(likelihood of an independent sample)}\\
&= \prodin \Lik_i(\param)
&& \text{(definition of likelihood components)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
